name: Alyissia
summary: In Aldrassil, Alyissia teaches young night elves to fight with strength and discipline. Her lessons prepare warriors to defend the young world tree.

sections.title: Martial Mentor of Shadowglen
sections.body: Inside Aldrassil, Alyissia trains young night elves to fight with steel and shield. They learn a path apart from nature magic and the priesthood. Kaldorei forces are known for Sentinels and stealthy archers, yet danger across Kalimdor also calls for warriors who can hold the front line. Wild creatures and corrupted grells press into Shadowglen, where Alyissia teaches battle fury, stances, and endurance.

faq.answer: Alyissia trains new night elf warriors in Aldrassil, at the heart of Shadowglen. She gives them their first lessons and simple martial exercises as they begin training in Teldrassil.
Alyissia is on the ground level inside Aldrassil's great hollow trunk, at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.
Alyissia receives the Simple Sigil carried by new night elf warriors. It introduces them to their warrior trainer in Aldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf warrior, Alyissia is your first mentor. She teaches early stances and martial discipline before you venture farther into Teldrassil's wilds.
As a night elf, you can learn the kaldorei's front-line martial discipline from Alyissia. Her teaching prepares you to defend Aldrassil's roots from corruption.
